{{Quote|No, no. I haven't seen anyone.|A Muun, to a security officer|<ref name="SC 105 />}}
Around [[9 ABY]],<ref>{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> a [[Gender|male]]<ref name="SC 105 SB" /> '''Muun''' was a guest in<ref name="SC 105 /> [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]]<ref>{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/bj8gqtnvm799njt6mjc6t|text=GR-FF-001420|date=2024-12-23}}</ref> during their official visit to the [[planet]] [[Lanupa]] as a member of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan|Banking Clan]].<ref name="SC 105" /> When off-duty, the man would indulge themselves in hotel services.<ref name="SC 105 EG">{{SW|url=series/skeleton-crew/season-1-episode-5-episode-guide|text="You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates" Episode Guide | Star Wars: Skeleton Crew}}</ref> One [[Standard day|day]], while taking a [[mud bath]] in the company of<ref name="SC 105" /> a [[Unidentified female Muun|female colleague]],<ref name="SC 105 SB" /> the [[Muun]] was approached by two<ref name="SC 105 /> [[security officer]]s<ref name="SC 105 AD">{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> who were looking for [[Jod Na Nawood]]. The individual, however, denied having seen anyone.<ref name="SC 105 />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Gender|male]] [[Muun]] made their debut in "[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]]," the fifth episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="SC 105" /> which premiered on [[December 24]], [[2024]].<ref>{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|date=2024-11-26|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref>
